names: Mission Bay Commons P13: Community Garden and SPARK Social SF
summary: Parcel P13, the middle of the three west Mission Bay Commons parcels (between Merrimac St and 4th St), holds a community garden and SPARK Social SF, as OCII's November 14, 2024 update (PDF p.17 legend) labels its current uses. They began as interim uses (OCII's timeline gives 2016 for the P13 pilot), pending the Mission Bay Future Parks Project, which Rec and Park says will renovate parcels P12, P13 and P15 into a permanent park. The permanent park is one project for P12, P13 and P15 together, so the schedule shown here (construction beginning late 2028 and opening early 2030 on Rec and Park's estimated schedule, expected dates that differ by source) is the project's, not specific to this parcel.

milestones.text: Interim-use pilot begins on parcel P13 (OCII's November 14, 2024 Future Parks update, slide 9 timeline: "MB Commons interim use pilots begin on P13 (2016), P15 (2017), P12 (2018)"); the slide names no uses, and the PDF p.17 legend labels P13 "Community Garden & SPARK Social SF"
SPARK Social SF, one of the uses OCII labels on P13, launches at 601 Mission Bay Blvd. North (Parklab's project page: 'launch date: May 2016'); the page covers Spark Social only
Rec and Park assumes management and maintenance of Mission Bay's park spaces

OCII's Mission Bay Future Parks update to its Citizens Advisory Committee names the Commons (P11, P12, P13, P15, P16, P17) among the parks being planned and shows a transfer to Rec and Park 'end of 2028, upon completion'

Rec and Park reports the Future Parks project moving into design: an RFQ (request for qualifications) 'was released in early August' (reported event) and a design team 'should be selected by mid-October' (an expected date; no source read says whether a team was selected)
Construction of the permanent park expected to begin 'late 2028' (Rec and Park estimated schedule)
milestones.basis_note: This is the Mission Bay Future Parks Project's schedule for P12, P13 and P15 together, not a date specific to this parcel. Rec and Park's page gives "Construction begins, Late 2028" and "Open to the Public, Early 2030" but also says the remaining parks "are anticipated to be complete by 2028", and slide 9 of OCII's November 14, 2024 update reads "Construction (mid-2027 thru 2028)" and "Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)", so these expected dates conflict and none is settled.

milestones.text: Permanent park expected to open to the public 'early 2030' (Rec and Park estimated schedule); the same page also says the remaining parks 'are anticipated to be complete by 2028'

open_questions: No official parcel boundary was found for P13: The outline is the OpenStreetMap park strip named Parklab (way 446183018), cut at Merrimac St and 4th St along DataSF's street centerlines plus 6.8 m; the lines between parcels are drawn from OCII's November 2024 drawing (PDF pp.5 and 17), which is not to scale, not from a survey. This parcel has no Assessor lot of its own: lot 8710003 (17,562 sq m) holds about 68% of P13, and P13 is only about 17% of that lot. At Merrimac St the paved crossing is only about 10-11 m wide with the centerline near its east edge, so the P13 edge falls about 2-3 m inside the community garden beds, leaving about 70-100 sq m of them out.

Which community garden is on P13 is not stated: Rec and Park's page lists an "Urban Sprouts Community Garden" among the uses on P12, P13 and P15 without saying which parcel, and OCII's legend says only "Community Garden" for P13.

Which parcel Spark Social SF sits on is given two ways by OCII's deck: the legend (PDF p.17) reads "P13 Community Garden & SPARK Social SF", while a survey slide (PDF p.31) reads "P13 & P15: Food Truck Park with Outdoor Dining (SPARK Social SF & Parklab Gardens)". This record follows the legend.
No opening date for the community garden was found; the only dates for P13 are the parcel-level pilot start (2016, OCII slide 9) and Spark Social's May 2016 launch on the operator's page.

The schedule differs between sources and is not resolved: Rec and Park's project page gives "Construction begins, Late 2028" and "Open to the Public, Early 2030" but also says the remaining parks "are anticipated to be complete by 2028", and slide 9 of OCII's November 14, 2024 update reads "Construction (mid-2027 thru 2028)" and "Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)". All of these are expected dates.

The OCII November 2024 deck's timeline (slide 9) is an image with no text layer; it was read on 2026-10-12 from a rendering of the slide. It gives "Construction (mid-2027 thru 2028)" and "Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)", which differ from Rec and Park's later page (construction beginning late 2028, opening early 2030).
